title: Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition
synopsis: The Game of the Year digital edition of Fallout 3 — earliest title in this issue’s Fallout sequence, retained under the archive Steam account.

custody.physical: Steam digital edition — Game of the Year build
custody.condition: Licensed copy held on the archive Steam account. No optical disc or boxed materials accompany this filing.

curatorNotes: Space held for writing on this Game of the Year Edition as the opening point of the Fallout sequence on this shelf.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam Game of the Year Edition license. No physical copy, manual, or insert is held. Collection photography does not apply; official cover artwork has been entered from the Steam library capsule.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC via the archive Steam client
preservation.originalHardware: PC · Steam Game of the Year Edition
preservation.compatibility: Playback depends on Steam account custody and the continued availability of this edition on the storefront.
preservation.concerns: Primary risks are account-bound license loss, client obsolescence, and storefront withdrawal. No offline installer is retained.
preservation.knownRevisions: Filed as Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition (Steam). The archive holds this licensed digital build, not a separate retail SKU.
preservation.availability: Accessible through the archive Steam account while the title remains offered for that account.
